subject.title: fix(plugins): speed up gateway startup and prevent stale plugin state

question: After real install/reload proof is attached, should this broad plugin lifecycle cache and gateway-registry isolation change be accepted as the canonical runtime behavior?
rationale: The protected `maintainer` label and cross-cutting compatibility surface require a human to confirm that the proposed lifecycle boundary is the intended long-term ownership model.

options.title: Review after runtime proof
options.body: Require redacted startup, reload, and readiness evidence for the exact head, then review the cache lifecycle and gateway-pinning design as one change.

options.title: Narrow the patch
options.body: Keep only the independently justified cache or gateway-isolation repairs and move broader lifecycle changes into a separately reviewed design slice.

recommendation.title: Review after runtime proof
recommendation.body: Require redacted startup, reload, and readiness evidence for the exact head, then review the cache lifecycle and gateway-pinning design as one change.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current lifecycle and gateway-isolation implementation and can provide the claimed runtime evidence and design context.
